title: Qualify complete shards without masking failures

rubric.text: Requires exact once coverage at a single candidate, static checks/build and preserved runner semantics; incomplete or semantically weaker shards do not replace the full command.

Allows only one evidence-supported load rerun in untouched code, preserves and reports first failure and rerun; changed-code or repeated failures use normal repair and required final-head CI remains the merge gate.
